title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-05-04
content:
Meeting: Private Deployment (ACME) - Weekly Sync - 2026-05-04
Owner: Aisha Patel (Customer Success)
Attendees: Aisha, Jonah (SRE lead), Sofia (Solutions Eng), Evan (ACME ENG), + ACME infra reps (Marcos, Li)

Goal: Quick status on VPC peering, on-prem appliance install, remaining network/security blockers, and next milestones for cutover dry-run 2 (target: 2026-05-18).

Agenda:
- Roll call + high-level status (2m)
- VPC peering & routing updates (Jonah) (10m)
- On-prem appliance install status (Sofia) (10m)
- Secrets/KMS & compliance checks (Aisha) (8m)
- Dry-run cutover plan + rollback criteria (Evan + ACME) (10m)
- Blockers & blockers owners (5m)
- Action items recap (5m)

Notes / discussion highlights:
- VPC peering: Jonah reported that ACME completed acceptance tests for route propagation, but BGP sessions dropped intermittently overnight. Jonah: "We saw flaps between 03:00-04:30 UTC, likely due to MTU mismatch on the transit link." Action: network team to validate MTU on their edge devices (owner: Marcos, target: 2026-05-06). Related ticket: JIRA-PD-2145.

- Firewall rules: ACME requires a deny-by-default firewall posture. We agreed to provide a minimal trusted-list for the appliance: control-plane (443, outbound TLS to S3 endpoints), metrics (TCP 9100), and NTP. Sofia to send final allowlist + CIDR ranges by 2026-05-05. Owner: Sofia.

- On-prem appliance install: Sofia completed install on node-1, but node-2 failed during package install due to init script timeout. Logs attached on Confluence (CONFLUENCE-PLAT-789). Temporary workaround: manual start performed; long-term fix: increase systemd TimeoutStartSec and patch installer to be idempotent. Owner: Sofia, ETA for patch: 2026-05-11.

- KMS/Key rotation: ACME security asks for AWS KMS-backed keys with automatic rotation and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance. We confirmed Redwood Private supports KMS integration; need to confirm permissions model and least-privilege IAM role. Action: Evan to share IRSA/IAM role draft (owner: Evan, due: 2026-05-06). Also need Splunk ingestion endpoint and diagram (owner: Li, due: 2026-05-07).

- Dry-run cutover plan: Target dry-run 2 scheduled 2026-05-18. Scope: route switch for 10% of traffic to private deployment, verify latency SLA (p50 < 120ms), validate cache warming and KV cache persistence across restarts. Rollback criteria: >3% error rate increase or 20% latency regressions for >10min. Evan to finalize runbook and rollback checklist by 2026-05-11. Owner: Evan.

- Compliance / Audit: ACME legal requested retention proof for audit trail of admin actions. We will enable audit logging and provide sample export (CSV + signed hash). Action: Aisha to draft audit export example and send to ACME legal for signoff (owner: Aisha, due 2026-05-08).

Blockers (priority sorted):
- BGP flaps causing intermittent routing failures (owner: Marcos / ACME network, blocker). ETA next check-in: 2026-05-06.
- Installer timeout on node-2 (owner: Sofia / Redwood install team, partial blocker until patch).
- KMS role document pending (owner: Evan / ACME), needed before final cutover.

Decisions made:
- Increase systemd TimeoutStartSec in installer as temporary measure; include permanent fix in next release.
- Proceed with dry-run 2 on 2026-05-18 provided the BGP flaps are resolved and KMS role is agreed.

Action items (owner + due date):
- Marcos (ACME network): validate MTU and BGP stability, share findings in JIRA-PD-2145, due 2026-05-06.
- Sofia (Redwood SE): send final firewall allowlist + CIDR ranges, due 2026-05-05.
- Sofia (Redwood SE): patch installer to fix init timeout and make idempotent, ETA 2026-05-11.
- Evan (ACME ENG): draft IAM/KMS role and cutover runbook + rollback checklist, due 2026-05-11.
- Li (ACME): provide Splunk ingest endpoint and diagram, due 2026-05-07.
- Aisha (CS): sample audit export CSV + signed hash, due 2026-05-08.
- Jonah (Redwood SRE): monitor for any new BGP flaps overnight and report, ongoing; escalate to infra on call if reoccurs.

Notes to self / follow-ups: 
- Remind infra to prepare short-lived debug creds for ACME engineers during dry-run (token expiry 4 hours).
- Draft customer-facing one-pager with cutover timeline and rollback criteria for exec review. Target send: 2026-05-10.
- Add a quick perf test for KV cache warmups in sandbox environment before dry-run 2.

Unresolved questions / open items:
- Who signs off on SLA acceptance for latency SLA — ACME product ops or Redwood customer success? (Action: Aisha to confirm during exec sync).
- Confirm retention window required for audit logs (ACME legal to confirm if 1 year vs 3 years).

Attachments / links:
- CONFLUENCE-PLAT-789 (installer logs + debug notes)
- JIRA-PD-2145 (network/BGP)
- Slack thread: slack://channel/private-deploy-acme (ongoing troubleshooting)

Next meeting: 2026-05-11 cadence (short check-in) — focus on BGP status and installer patch verification.

TODO (quick):
- [ ] Send allowlist (Sofia)
- [ ] Patch installer (Sofia)
- [ ] IAM/KMS draft (Evan)
- [ ] Audit export sample (Aisha)

End of notes.
